translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Saypita Jesús nergan: “Manarä wanurmi waquinniqui ricayämanquipä lapanpäpis munayyog cashgäta.”
Altunnin jircacho Jesucristo chipipiycag ricacushgan
Saypita sogta junagtami Pedruta, Santiaguta y Juanta pushacurcur Jesús wisargan jirca puntaman. Saychömi paycuna ricaycaptin segaypa chipipergan.
Saynömi mödananpis rashtano yurag ricacur empañayparä asicyargan. Mayjina tagsharpis manami pipis saynöga yoragäsinsu.
Saychömi ricayargan Moiseswan Elías yuriparcur Jesuswan parlaycäyagta.

Sayta ricaycurmi paycuna mansacash ricacuyargan. Sauraga Pedro mana yarpachacuylapa nergan Jesusta: “Alipämi nogacuna cayman shayämushcä, taytay. Cananga rurayäshä quimsa suclata: jucta gampä, jucta Moisespä y jucta Eliaspä.”
Sayno parlaycaptinmi pucutay sapacurcorgan. Saypitami Tayta Diosninsi nimorgan: “Payga cuyay surëmi. Pay nishushgayquicunata cäsucuyay.”
Saypitaga yapay nuquircuyänanpä Jesús japalannami caycänä.
Nircurnami jircapita cutiycämur paycunata Jesús nergan: “Jircacho ricashgayquita pitapis ama wilapäyanquiräsu wanushgäpita noga cawarimushgäyag.”

Sayno Jesús niptinmi paycunaga say ricashgancunata pitapis wilapäyargansu. Sayno carpis “Wanushgäpita cawarimushämi” nishganta manami tantyayargansu. Saymi quiquinpura parlaycäyargan: “¿Imanirtä nicämansi cawarimunanpä cashganta?” nir.
Saypitanami paycuna Jesusta tapuyargan: “Moisés guelgashgan leycunata yachasegcuna niyan Cristo shamunanpä puntata Eliasrä shamunanpä cashgantami. Sayno nicaptenga ¿imanirtä Elías shamunräsu?”

Sayno niyaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Elías yapay shamunanpä cashganta niyashgannölami Elías mayna shamush. Elías shamur wilacuptinpis manami runacuna chasquicuyashgasu wilacushganta. Chasquicuyänanpa trucanga payta wanusiyargan Tayta Diosninsipa palabrancho nishgannölami. Saynölami runacuna nogatapis chiquimar fiyupa nacasiyämangapä.”
Wanuy gueshyawan gueshyaycag magtata Jesucristo cachacäsishgan
Quimsa discïpuluncunawan Jesús say jircapita cutimurmi tarergan Moisés guelgashganta yachasegcunawan waquin cag discïpuluncuna rimanacuycagta. Paycunatami asca runacuna juntaparaycäyargan.
Sayman Jesús chaycagta ricarmi runacuna cushish cörrila taripäyargan saludananpä.
Nircurmi discïpuluncunata Jesús taporgan: “¿Imanirtä Moisés guelgashganta yachasegcunawan rimanacuycäyanqui?”
Sayno tapuycaptinmi juc runana nergan: “Supay upayäsishgan surëtami apamushcä cachacäsipämänayquipä, taytay.

Maycho caycaptinpis say supay elagpitami surëta gaparäsin, pampaman sagtan, pogushaytapis agtusin y quiruntapis uchusin. Saynöpis wanuy gueshyami sarin. Saymi discïpuluyquicunaman apamuptëpis say supayta garguyta camäpacuyashgasu.”
Saymi Jesús nergan saycho cag runacunata: “¡Yäracuyniynag runacuna! ¿Imayyagrä gamcunawan caycäshä? Mä apamuy say magtata.
Sayno niptinmi Jesuspa puntanman say magtata apayargan. Saymi Jesusta ricärir magtata supay pampaman sagtariycorgan. Saymi say magta pogushayta agtur pampacho goshpargan.
Saymi magtapa papäninta Jesús taporgan: “¿Imaypitanatä suriquita supay sayno nacaycäsin?” Sayno tapuptin papänin nergan: “Wamra cashganpita-pasami sayno nacaycäsin, taytay.
Asca cuti wanusiyta munashpanmi ninamanpis yacumanpis say supay sagtash. Sayno mana nacananpä surëta cachacäsipaycalämay, taytay.”
Sayno ruwacuptinmi Jesús nergan: “Rasunpaypa yäracamaptiquega cachacäsipäshayquimi. Yäracamagcunapäga manami imapis ajasu caycan.”
Sauraga magtapa papänin cushish nergan: “Shumag mana yäracuptëpis yanapaycalämay lapan shongöwan gamman yäracunäpä, taytay.”

Sauraga asca runacuna burrurruyla shamuycagta ricarmi say magtacho caycag supayta jucla Jesús gargorgan: “¡Upayäseg y mana parlaseg supay! ¡Cay magtapita jucla yarguy! ¡Cananpitaga imaypis amana cutiynasu cay magtaman!”
Sauraga say supay gaparar yapay sagtargan magtata. Nircurna yargurir aywacorgan wanushtano cachariycur. Sayno jitaraycagta ricarmi runacuna yarpäyargan wanushgana cashganta.
Sauraga maquipita sarircur Jesús say magtata cachacashtana sharcasergan.
Saypitana discïpuluncunawan Jesús juc wayiman yaycorgan. Saychönami discïpuluncuna Jesusta tapuyargan: “¿Imanirtä nogacuna garguyta camäpacuyashcäsu say supayta?” niyashpan.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “[Ayunar] Tayta Diosninsita manacurrämi say-nirag supaytaga garguyanquipä.”
Wanunanpä cashganta Jesucristo yapay wilacushgan
Saypita aywacuyashpannami discïpuluncunawan päsayargan Galilea provinciapa. Discïpuluncunawan wilanacuyänan cashgami Jesús munargansu sayman aywashganta runacuna musyayänanta.
Saychömi discïpuluncunata Jesús nergan: “Juc runami nogata entregamanga chiquimagnëcunapa maquinman. Sayno captinpis wanusimashganpita quimsa junagtami cawarimushäpä.”
Sayno wilaptinpis Jesús nishgancunata paycuna manami tantyayargansu. Sayno mana tantyarpis tapuytami isanga mansapäyargan.
Wamrano nogansipis canansipä Jesucristo tantyasishgan
Saypita Capernaum marcaman chaycur wayicho caycashpanna discïpuluncunata taporgan: “Nänipa shamur ¿imapitatä parlaycäyashcanqui?”
Discïpuluncunaga mandag cayta guechunacur rimanacuyash carmi Jesús tapuptinpis pengacuyashpan upälacuyargan.
Saypita Jesús jamaycushpan chunca ishcay (12) discïpuluncunata nergan: “Maygayquicunapis más munayyog cayta munarga ashmaynöla pï-maytapis yanapäyay.”
Nircurnami juc wamrata margarcur paycunata nergan:
“Cay wamratano mana cuentash cagcunata chasquicorga nogata chasquicamagnömi caycäyanqui. Nogata chasquicamarga cachamag Taytätapis chasquicuycäyanquimi.”
Supayta garguptin mana michäyänanpä Jesucristo yäsishgan
Saymi discïpulun Juan nergan: “Nogacuna ricayashcä juc runata gampa jutiquicho supaycunata garguycagta, taytay. Saymi nogansiwan mana puriptin jutiquita mana jogarinanpä michäyashcä.”
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Cananpitaga ama michäyanquisu. Nogansiwan mana purirpis jutëcho supaycunata gargorga alitami ruraycan. Sayno carga manami conträsu caycan.
Pipis contransi mana sharcorga favorninsimi caycan.
Chasquicamagcunata pipis noga-raycu juc pusillu yaculatapis macyaptenga Tayta Diosninsi paytapis premiutami gongapä.”
Jusaman pitapis mana tunisinansipä Jesucristo tantyasishgan
Jesús cayno mastapis nergan: “Tayta Diosman yäracogta cuidä pitapis jusalicasiyanquiman. Jusaman tunisicogcunataga más alimi canman mulïnu rumita cuncanman sheguparcur lamarman garpuriyaptinpis.

“Sayno cananpä caycaptenga maquiqui jusalicasishuptiqui roguriycuy. Imaypis mana upeg ninaman ishcan maquiquiwan gaycush canayquipa trucanga más alimi canman juc maquiyoglapis Tayta Diosninsipa naupanman chaptiqui.
[Infiernuman chagcunaga mana ushacaypami nacangapä.]
“Chaquiquipis jusalicasishuptiquega roguriycuy. Imaypis mana upeg ninaman ishcan chaquiquiwan gaycush canayquipa trucanga más alimi canman juc chaquiyoglapis Tayta Diosninsipa naupanman chaptiqui.
[Infiernuman chagcunaga mana ushacaypami nacangapä.]
“Nawiquipis jusalicasishuptiquega ogtiriycuy. Ishcan nawiyog infiernuman gaycush canayquipa trucanga más alimi canman wiscu nawilapis Tayta Diosninsipa naupanman chaptiqui.
Infiernuman chagcunaga mana ushacaypami nacangapä.
“Jusata mana cacharegcunaga lapanmi infiernucho imayyagpis nacayangapä. Noga nishgäcunata chasquicogcunami isanga cay pasacho mayjina nacarpis gloriaman char ali cawayangapä.
Musyashgayquinöpis cachega alimi caycan micuyta gustuta gonanpä. Micuyta gustuta gonanpä cachi ali cashganno gamcunapis runa mayiquiwan cuyanacur ali cawayay.”
